title: Pass a failure up to the caller
objective: Let a failure from one function, or from a step inside it, be handled by whoever called it, using and pass the problem on.

body.text: Sometimes a function does a step that can fail, and the function does not know what to do about it. Instead of handling the failure there, it can pass it on. Write and pass the problem on after the attempt. The function then fails with the same problem, and the caller handles it with attempt, as usual.

body.title: Let the caller decide
body.code:
function load score
    takes text called raw
    returns a number
    can fail
    attempt number from raw and pass the problem on
    gives back result

attempt load score "x" if it fails then
    say "failed"
otherwise
    say "ok"

body.text: The function gives back result only when the step worked. If it failed, the line after it never runs, because the failure has already been passed on.

body.title: Show the reason
body.code:
function parse age
    takes text called answer
    returns a number
    can fail
    attempt number from answer and pass the problem on
    gives back result

attempt parse age "abc" if it fails then
    say problem
otherwise
    say result
expected: "abc" is not a number — a number is digits, maybe starting with a minus.
